narrative_alignment_note: Published winner's own OOS-Sharpe-by-lead curve (foreground, HY-IG Spread (v1)) on the DAILY axis; deployed lead 0d = 1.41. Grey bars: best-of-any-signal envelope on the same daily grid. Buy-and-hold SPY = 0.81. On the pair's OWN daily grid the published winner sits at the envelope peak (0d) — both its own curve and the best-of-any-signal envelope peak there, and the profile decays monotonically as the signal is lagged. This is a SAME-DAY (coincident) edge: when the credit-stress regime flips, equities move the same day — not a multi-month leading indicator. The grid extension to 126/252 trading days surfaces no long-lead edge (both fail a t>3 hurdle) — multiple-testing noise, as credit→equity coincident/short-horizon transmission predicts.
